name: Physiotherapy
tagline: Sports, remedial, rehab, dry needling, telehealth
extra_prompt: You are booking for a physiotherapy clinic. Ask about the injury or condition, how long it has been present, and any scans or doctor's referral. Ask about goals, sport, and whether they prefer in-clinic or telehealth. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after assessment. Do not provide clinical advice or promise a specific recovery outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: {price_note} Initial consultations are longer than follow-ups, so they are priced separately. We confirm the fee before you book.

kb.q: Can I claim on private health?
kb.a: Yes, if you have physiotherapy cover with your health fund. We offer HICAPS on-the-spot claiming where available, so ask us at booking whether your fund is supported.

kb.q: Do I need a doctor's referral?
kb.a: No referral is needed for private physio. Some plans, such as Medicare EPC, and some insurance claims need a referral, so check your plan before booking.
Yes, our physios are trained in dry needling. We explain the treatment and get your consent before any needles are used.
Yes, we do sports physio and return-to-sport programs. Tell us your sport, your level and your goals so we can plan your return.
Yes, we do post-operative rehabilitation. Please bring your surgeon's discharge notes or post-operative instructions to your first visit.
Yes, we do pre-surgery preparation. We work on strength and mobility before your operation, which can help your recovery afterwards.

kb.q: Do you do women's health physio?
kb.a: Yes, we treat women's health conditions, including pelvic floor and prenatal and postnatal care. Tell us what you are looking for when you book.

kb.q: Do you do men's health physio?
kb.a: Yes, we treat men's health conditions, including pelvic health and continence. Tell us your concern when you book so we can plan the first visit.
Yes, we treat children and babies. Please bring a parent or guardian to the first visit and tell us about any relevant medical history.
Yes, we offer video consultations. Telehealth suits follow-ups and advice, but some assessments need to be done in person.
Yes, home visits are available in the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb, and we will quote the home visit fee at booking.
Yes, we run clinical pilates in one-on-one and small group formats. Clinical pilates is part of your treatment plan, so ask us which format suits you.
Initial consults are 45 to 60 minutes. Follow-ups are 30 minutes, and extended follow-ups are 45 minutes.

kb.q: How many sessions will I need?
kb.a: It depends on the condition. We give you an estimated plan after assessment, and we review it as your progress changes.

kb.q: Do you offer a cancellation policy?
kb.a: Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please let us know as early as you can so we can offer the time to someone else.
Our physios hold [AHPRA registration number] and [insurance details]. Ask us for copies before you book.
Bring any scans, reports and referrals you have, along with shorts and comfortable clothing. Wear clothing that lets us see the area being treated.
Yes, we prescribe home exercises and can send them to you via an app. Your program is updated as your condition changes.
Yes, we use manual therapy alongside exercise. Hands-on treatment is combined with exercise as part of your plan.

templates.booking_confirmation: Hi {customer}, your {job} with {business} is booked for {date}.
templates.reminder: Reminder: your {job} at {business} is on {date}. Please bring your card and any referral.
templates.quote_intro: Here is your estimate. Your practitioner will confirm the plan at your appointment.
templates.invoice_note: Thank you. Health fund claims are handled by the practice where applicable.

required_information.label: Referral or Medicare details (only if the practice needs them)
Clinical details stay in the clinical record, not in booking notes

compliance.guidance: Health practitioners usually need registration (for example with AHPRA where it applies) and current professional indemnity insurance. Keep clinical details in the clinical record, not in general booking fields. Follow your state health privacy rules.
items: Clinical notes kept only in the clinical record
